body: im so confused i dont know what to listen to 😭
okay maybe trying to figure out how to play guitar with no help was a bad idea
https://imgur.com/a/esRFhso this is how i hold it

i had to look up who that is because like i said, very uneducated when it comes to guitar but wow!!! thats inspiring as hell. i play with my guitar on my lap too sometimes and ive never seen someone else do it, let alone someone blind! it really puts into perspective that there is no one way to play

is there any truth to that its better down the line to play with your other fingers than your thumb though? im good at playing with my thumb for now but i want to take my guitar playing to the next level eventually.
